newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends down in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends down in slow trading.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended down in slow trading on Thursday with most investors losing interest in trading, traders said.
The only traded October 1996 contract ended at an intra-day low of 2,170 yuan, losing 30 yuan. It opened at a high of 2,185. Volume rose to 2,100 tonnes from 600.
Traders said most investors did not want to build long positions, and forecast continued falls in the next few days.
"Low open interest and over-speculation made investors lose interest in trading," one trader said.
Open interest of the October contract was 1,370 lots, unchanged from that of last Wednesday. One lot is five tonnes.
Recent restrictions by Beijing on futures trading also discouraged long position holders, traders said.
"Rice is likely to continue to fall with weak market sentiment until positive news appears," a second trader said.
